[7:05AM] #LagIbdExpWay
#3MB
#TrafficUpdate

It's still an encouraging Vehicular flow coming inward Berger from Kara bridge down to Tollgate except slight delay at Tollgate turning and Ikosi/7Up bus stop due to the activities of the commercial buses.

Proceeding towards Estate/Alapere and Ogudu/Ifako is also looking good at the moment.

Traffic moves  gradually approaching Iyana Oworo and Ilaje due to bus stop activities at Iyana Oworo coupled with a broken down car connecting the Third mainland bridge.

It's moving faster beyond Ilaje en route Unilag water front and Adekunle.
Traffic is flowing gradually exiting Adekunle merging point towards the Adeniji end.

On the return journey, it's a good movement all the way from Adeniji back to Iyana Oworo and Berger.
#FollowLASTMA

ABISO SA PUBLIKO

Mas pinadali na ang pagbabayad online dahil nagsimula na ang pag isyu ng Electronic Official Receipt (eOR), para sa Traffic Violation at City Ordinance Violation sa Lungsod.

Hindi na kailangang maghintay ng 2-3 working days para ma-validate at ma-isyuhan ng Official Receipt ang iyong online payment kapag nagbayad sa QC e-Services https://t.co/8bq91ddwqv "OVR Online Payment" via GCASH eOR Enabled payment method.

Automatic na din mali-LIFT ang iyong Alarm Tag sa LTO-LTMS system.

Hindi na din kailangan magpunta sa opisina ng Traffic and Transport Management Department (TTMD) - OVR Section para sa hard copy ng Official Receipt ng iyong pinagbayaran online dahil may Electronic Official Receipt (eOR) na.

Para sa ibang detalye at impormasyon, makipag-ugnayan lamang sa Traffic and Transport Management Department (TTMD) - OVR Section:
Cellphone: 09621740143
Landline: 8-703-8906
Email: ttmd@quezoncity.gov.ph         
          qcovr.ttmd@quezoncity.gov.ph
